### Discovering Divine Design
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/discovering-divine-design/
Passage: Genesis 24:27
Points:
- When believers walk in fellowship with God, looking back reveals His providential guidance.
- Continual anxiety over guidance can hinder devotion, whereas spiritual maturity walks in childlike obedience.
- Inner spiritual conflict acts as the Holy Spirit’s prompt to stop and discern God's will.
- Spiritual discipline trains us to perceive God’s appointed design in ordinary details rather than seeing chance.
- Christian consistency means remaining devoted to God rather than clinging rigidly to personal convictions.

### Follow the Leader
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-8-2006-1377027.html
Passage: Genesis 24:58-60
Points:
- Rebekah demonstrated immediate, courageous faith by agreeing to leave home for an uncertain future.
- Trusting God often means stepping forward into unfamiliar situations before knowing the outcome.
- Family blessings and fruitfulness followed Rebekah's verbal commitment to step out in faith.
- Entrusting one's path to God requires resting in His sovereignty over relationships and circumstances.
